Title: Expose a Function App via API Management by linking it to a new or existing API is now available

Body.Content:
You can expose HTTP trigger Functions through a new or an existing API in API Management. If your Function App has Application Insights logging enabled, you may also opt-in for automatic configuration of logging your API activity to the same Application Insights instance.  

 

Once the Function App is linked with API Management, you can manage API operations, apply policies, edit and download OpenAPI specification files, or navigate to API Management instance for a full-featured experience. 

You can learn more about how to expose your Function Apps with API Management in this documentation article. We discussed the benefits of API Management in microservices architectures in this blog post. 

Learn more
